items.title: Pacific islanders face a ‘sickening disconnect’ between Cop31 and the climate devastation at their doorstep
items.trail: As the UN summit nears its close, the ‘frustratingly’ slow progress and lack of focus on fossil fuel transition have the Pacific turning elsewhere for help

image.alt: Albon Ishoda stands with hands clasped in a large hall with Cop attendees behind him
image.caption: Albon Ishoda, an ambassador from the Marshall Islands, says the lack of funding for the Pacific Resisilience Facility is beyond disappointing.

items.title: ‘We’re the most arrogant of all apes!’ A delightfully mind-expanding encounter with Peter Gabriel
items.trail: From sampling to streaming, the rock legend has always been ahead of the curve. Now, back with an epic new album, he talks about success on his own terms and his theories on virtually everything

image.alt: A closeup image of a man with a grey beard with pink and blue lighting in front of him
image.caption: ‘There’s so much intelligence we’ve chosen to ignore’ … Peter Gabriel.

items.title: Pink Rabbit: the provocative bedroom drama about a Muslim OnlyFans star interrupted by her mum
items.trail: In Farah Ashraf’s solo show an obedient daughter secretly does online sex work as ‘PersianBaby’. The actor and writer explains how two worlds collide in her darkly funny play

image.alt: Press image for Pink Rabbit: a woman lying down holds a pink vibrator, finger to lips
image.caption: ‘Brown women are not monoliths’ … Farah Ashraf in Pink Rabbit.
